headline: Bapanas Prepares Transport Subsidy to Keep Chicken Meat Prices Reasonable
summary: The National Food Agency (Bapanas) is preparing a subsidy for chicken meat transport costs to regions with volatile prices. The aim is to keep prices reasonable and strengthen distribution.
why: Food price stabilisation measures affect inflation and consumer spending, and food agencies in Indonesia use subsidies to manage supply.
